```sql
SELECT T1.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T1
JOIN Team_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
WHERE T2.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal' AND SUBSTR(T2.date, 1, 4) = '2014'
GROUP BY T1.team_long_name
HAVING AVG(T2.chanceCreationPassing) > T2.chanceCreationPassing
ORDER BY T2.chanceCreationPassing DESC;
```

```sql
SELECT T1.team_short_name
FROM Team AS T1
JOIN Team_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
WHERE T2.buildUpPlaySpeed = 31 AND T2.buildUpPlayDribbling = 53 AND T2.buildUpPlayPassing = 32;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN T2.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN T1.ball_control ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN T1.id ELSE NULL END)) -
    (SUM(CASE WHEN T2.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN T1.ball_control ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN T1.id ELSE NULL END)) AS difference
FROM 
    Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN 
    Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' THEN T2.overall_rating ELSE 0 END) - 
         SUM(CASE WHEN T1.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' THEN T2.overall_rating ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 
    100 / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' THEN T2.overall_rating ELSE 0 END)) AS percentage
FROM 
    Player AS T1
JOIN 
    Player_Attributes AS T2
ON 
    T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE 
    T2.date = '2013-07-12';
```

```sql
SELECT L.name
FROM League L
JOIN Match M ON L.id = M.league_id
WHERE M.season = '2009/2010'
GROUP BY L.name
HAVING AVG(M.home_team_goal) > AVG(M.away_team_goal);
```

```sql

FROM Match AS T1
JOIN League AS T2 ON T1.league_id = T2.id

```

```sql
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_api_id)
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.birthday) < '1986' AND pa.defensive_work_rate = 'High';
```

```sql
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN preferred_foot = 'left' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(player_fifa_api_id) AS percentage_left_foot
FROM Player_Attributes
JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', Player.birthday) BETWEEN '1987' AND '1992';
```

```sql

```

```sql

```

```sql
SELECT 
    (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', T1.birthday)) - 
    (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', T1.birthday)) AS age
FROM 
    Player AS T1
JOIN 
    Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE 
    T2.sprint_speed >= 97 
    AND T2.date BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2015-12-31';
```

```sql
SELECT 
    ((SELECT overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk') 
    - SELECT overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Paulin Puel')) 
    / (SELECT overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Paulin Puel'))) * 100 AS percentage_increase;
```

```sql
SELECT C.name, AVG(P.weight) AS average_weight
FROM Player P
JOIN Match M ON P.player_api_id IN (M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5, M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11, M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5, M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11)
JOIN Country C ON M.country_id = C.id
GROUP BY C.name
ORDER BY average_weight DESC
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql

SELECT SUM(T1.away_team_goal)
FROM Match AS T1

JOIN Player AS P6 ON T1.away_player_6 = P6.player_api_id
JOIN Player AS P7 ON T1.away_player_7 = P7.player_api_id
```

```sql
SELECT
```

```sql
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)`,
    f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`,

    f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`,
    s.Charter,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 60 OR f.NumGE1500 > 30 AS Eligible,
    f.AvgScrRead + f.AvgScrMath + f.AvgScrWrite AS TotalSAT,
    CASE 
        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` >= 75 THEN 'High'
        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` >= 50 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS FRPMLevel
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)` + f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500
ORDER BY 
    s.County,
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)` + f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` DESC,
    FRPMLevel,
    TotalSAT DESC;
```

```sql
SELECT
```

```sql
    sats.AvgScrRead,
    sats.AvgScrMath,
    sats.AvgScrWrite,
    sats.NumGE1500,
    CASE 
        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` > 70 AND sats.NumGE1500 >= 20 THEN 'Highly Unexpectedly Well'
        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` < 30 AND sats.NumGE1500 < 10 THEN 'Highly Unexpectedly Poorly'
        ELSE 'Expected Performance'
    END AS Performance
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
JOIN 
    satscores sats ON f.CDSCode = sats.cds
WHERE 
    f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 0
    AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 100
ORDER BY 
    f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    s.NCESDist, 
    s.School, 
    s.Charter, 
    s.StatusType, 
    s.OpenDate, 
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)`, 
    CASE 
        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 75 THEN 'High Poverty'
        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 50 THEN 'Medium Poverty'
        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 25 THEN 'Low Poverty'
        ELSE 'Very Low Poverty'
    END AS PovertyClassification,
    ss.AvgScrRead, 
    ss.AvgScrMath, 
    ss.AvgScrWrite, 
    (ss.AvgScrRead + ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrWrite) / 3 AS AvgSATScore,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC) AS EnrollmentRanking
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
JOIN 
    satscores ss ON f.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE 
    s.DOCType = 'State Special Schools' 
    AND s.SOC = '31' 
    OR s.SOC LIKE '3%'
ORDER BY 
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC;
```

```sql
WITH colusa AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_schools,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Charter = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS charter_schools,
    SUM(CASE WHEN `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_free_schools,
    AVG(AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) AS avg_sat_score,
    SUM(`Free Meal Count (K-12)`) AS total_free_meals,
    SUM(`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS total_enrollment
  FROM 
    frpm
  JOIN 
    schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
  WHERE 
    County = 'Colusa'
),
humboldt AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_schools,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Charter = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS charter_schools,
    SUM(CASE WHEN `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_free_schools,
    AVG(AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) AS avg_sat_score,
    SUM(`Free Meal Count (K-12)`) AS total_free_meals,
    SUM(`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS total_enrollment
  FROM 
    frpm
  JOIN 
    schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
  WHERE 
    County = 'Humboldt'
)
SELECT 
  colusa.total_schools / humboldt.total_schools AS school_ratio,
  colusa.charter_schools / humboldt.charter_schools AS charter_ratio,
  colusa.high_free_schools / humboldt.high_free_schools AS high_free_ratio,
  colusa.avg_sat_score / humboldt.avg_sat_score AS sat_score_ratio,
  colusa.total_free_meals / humboldt.total_free_meals AS free_meals_ratio,
  colusa.total_enrollment / humboldt.total_enrollment AS enrollment_ratio;
```

```sql
WITH avg_salary AS (
  SELECT AVG(A11) AS national_avg FROM district
),
high_income_districts AS (
  SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A11 > (SELECT national_avg FROM avg_salary)
),
loan_details AS (
  SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    d.A2 AS district,
    d.A3 AS region,
    AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount,
    SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount,
    COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count
  FROM 
    account a
  JOIN 
    loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
  WHERE 
    l.amount > 300000
  GROUP BY 
    a.account_id, d.district_id, d.A2, d.A3
),
income_classification AS (
  SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN SUM(t.amount) > 1000000 THEN 'High Income'
      WHEN SUM(t.amount) > 500000 THEN 'Medium Income'
      ELSE 'Low Income'
    END AS income_category
  FROM 
    account a
  LEFT JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  GROUP BY 
    a.account_id
),
transaction_activity AS (
  SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_income
  FROM 
    account a
  LEFT JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  GROUP BY 
    a.account_id
),
savings_ratio AS (
  SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END)) / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS savings_ratio
  FROM 
    account a
  LEFT JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  GROUP BY 
    a.account_id
),
ranked_accounts AS (
  SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    d.A2 AS district,
    d.A3 AS region,
    l.avg_loan_amount,
    l.total_loan_amount,
    l.loan_count,
    i.income_category,
    t.total_income,
    t.total_expense,
    t.net_income,
    s.savings_ratio,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.A3 ORDER BY l.total_loan_amount DESC) AS rank
  FROM 
    account a
  JOIN 
    loan_details l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
  JOIN 
    income_classification i ON a.account_id = i.account_id
  JOIN 
    transaction_activity t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  JOIN 
    savings_ratio s ON a.account_id = s.account_id
  JOIN 
    district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE 
    (t.net_income > 0 OR t.total_income = 0)
    AND a.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM high_income_districts)
)
SELECT 
  * 
FROM 
  ranked_accounts 
WHERE 
  rank <= 100;
```

```sql
WITH AlamedaCounty AS (
  SELECT 
    s.CDSCode,
    s.School,
    s.Charter,
    s.LowGrade,
    s.HighGrade,
    f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)] AS FreeMealRate,
    f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)] - (SELECT AVG([Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)]) FROM frpm WHERE `County Name` = 'Alameda') AS FreeMealRateDeviation,
    CASE 
      WHEN COALESCE(fs.AvgScrRead, 0) + COALESCE(fs.AvgScrMath, 0) + COALESCE(fs.AvgScrWrite, 0) < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
      WHEN COALESCE(fs.AvgScrRead, 0) + COALESCE(fs.AvgScrMath, 0) + COALESCE(fs.AvgScrWrite, 0) BETWEEN 1200 AND 1500 THEN 'Average'
      WHEN COALESCE(fs.AvgScrRead, 0) + COALESCE(fs.AvgScrMath, 0) + COALESCE(fs.AvgScrWrite, 0) > 1500 THEN 'Above Average'
      ELSE 'No SAT Data'
    END AS SATPerformanceLevel
  FROM 
    schools s
  JOIN 
    frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
  JOIN 
    satscores fs ON s.CDSCode = fs.cds
  WHERE 
    s.County = 'Alameda'
),
HighestFreeMealRate AS (
  SELECT 
    CDSCode,
    MAX(FreeMealRate) AS MaxFreeMealRate
  FROM 
    AlamedaCounty
  GROUP BY 
    CDSCode
)
SELECT 
  ac.CDSCode,
  ac.School,
  ac.Charter,
  ac.LowGrade,
  ac.HighGrade,
  ac.FreeMealRate,
  ac.FreeMealRateDeviation,
  ac.SATPerformanceLevel
FROM 
  AlamedaCounty ac
JOIN 
  HighestFreeMealRate hrm ON ac.CDSCode = hrm.CDSCode AND ac.FreeMealRate = hrm.MaxFreeMealRate;
```

```sql
WITH PrachaticeAccounts AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, a.frequency, a.date, c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, d.A2 AS district_name
  FROM account a
  JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
  JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE d.A2 = 'Prachatice'
),
TransactionStats AS (
  SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense
  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
),
LoanInfo AS (
  SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
  FROM loan
  GROUP BY account_id
),
CustomerCategory AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, 
         CASE 
           WHEN l.loan_count > 0 AND t.transaction_count > 10 THEN 'High Activity'
           WHEN l.loan_count > 0 THEN 'Loan Customer'
           WHEN t.transaction_count > 10 THEN 'Active Customer'
           ELSE 'Regular Customer'
         END AS customer_category
  FROM PrachaticeAccounts a
  LEFT JOIN TransactionStats t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  LEFT JOIN LoanInfo l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
),
NetBalance AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, a.frequency, a.date, c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, d.A2 AS district_name, 
         t.total_income, t.total_expense, t.transaction_count, l.loan_count, cc.customer_category,
         (t.total_income - t.total_expense) AS net_balance
  FROM PrachaticeAccounts a
  JOIN TransactionStats t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  JOIN LoanInfo l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
  JOIN CustomerCategory cc ON a.account_id = cc.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
)
SELECT * FROM NetBalance ORDER BY net_balance DESC;
```

```sql
WITH district_crime AS (
  SELECT 
    d.district_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_clients,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' AND d.A15 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS crime_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS total_districts,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS total_accounts,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS total_loans,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.card_id) AS total_cards,
    AVG(d.A15) AS avg_dispositions,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.client_id) AS clients_with_loans,
    AVG(CASE WHEN julianday('now') - julianday(c.birth_date) < 30 * 365 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS young_clients,
    AVG(CASE WHEN julianday('now') - julianday(c.birth_date) BETWEEN 30 * 365 AND 50 * 365 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS middle_aged_clients,
    AVG(CASE WHEN julianday('now') - julianday(c.birth_date) > 50 * 365 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS senior_clients
  FROM 
    district d
  JOIN 
    client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
  LEFT JOIN 
    account a ON c.client_id = a.client_id
  LEFT JOIN 
    loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
  LEFT JOIN 
    card ca ON a.account_id = ca.account_id
  LEFT JOIN 
    disp cl ON a.account_id = cl.account_id
  WHERE 
    d.A15 > 0
  GROUP BY 
    d.district_id
),
ranked_districts AS (
  SELECT 
    district_id,
    male_clients,
    crime_count,
    total_districts,
    total_accounts,
    total_loans,
    total_cards,
    avg_dispositions,
    clients_with_loans,
    young_clients,
    middle_aged_clients,
    senior_clients,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY crime_count DESC) AS rank
  FROM 
    district_crime
)
SELECT 
  district_id,
  male_clients,
  crime_count,
  total_districts,
  total_accounts,
  total_loans,
  total_cards,
  avg_dispositions,
  clients_with_loans,
  young_clients,
  middle_aged_clients,
  senior_clients
FROM 
  ranked_districts
WHERE 
  rank = 2;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    c.client_id,
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    a.account_id,
    a.district_id AS account_district_id,
    a.frequency,
    a.date AS account_open_date,
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_transactions,
    COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count,
    AVG(t.amount) AS average_transaction_amount,
    MAX(t.amount) AS max_transaction_amount,
    MIN(t.amount) AS min_transaction_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.k_symbol) AS distinct_transaction_types,
    COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count,
    SUM(l.amount) AS total_loans,
    AVG(l.amount) AS average_loan_amount,
    MAX(l.amount) AS max_loan_amount,
    MIN(l.amount) AS min_loan_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.k_symbol) AS distinct_loan_types
FROM 
    client c
JOIN 
    disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN 
    account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE 
    c.gender = 'F' 
    AND c.birth_date = '1976-01-29'
GROUP BY 
    c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, d.A2, a.account_id, a.district_id, a.frequency, a.date;
```

```sql

    disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id

    account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE 
    c.gender = 'F'

    c.client_id, l.loan_id

    l.amount DESC
```

```sql
WITH loan_stats AS (
  SELECT
    d.A2 AS region,
    CASE
      WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
      WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
      ELSE 'Large'
    END AS loan_size,
    COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS running_loans
  FROM
    loan l
  JOIN
    account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN
    district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE
    l.amount < 100000
  GROUP BY
    d.A2, loan_size
),
overall_stats AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_running_loans,
    COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans
  FROM
    loan l
  WHERE
    l.amount < 100000
)
SELECT
  ls.region,
  ls.loan_size,
  (ls.running_loans * 100.0 / ls.total_loans) AS region_percentage,
  (ls.running_loans * 100.0 / os.total_running_loans) AS overall_percentage
FROM
  loan_stats ls
CROSS JOIN
  overall_stats os
ORDER BY
  ls.region, ls.loan_size;
```

```sql
WITH monthly_transactions AS (
  SELECT 
    strftime('%Y-%m', t.date) AS month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS decin_count,
    COUNT(t.trans_id) AS total_transactions,
    AVG(t.amount) AS average_amount,
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount
  FROM 
    trans t
  JOIN 
    account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN 
    district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE 
    strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993'
  GROUP BY 
    month
),
yearly_average AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(decin_count) AS avg_decin_percentage
  FROM 
    monthly_transactions
)
SELECT 
  mt.month,
  (mt.decin_count * 100.0 / mt.total_transactions) AS decin_percentage,
  mt.average_amount,
  mt.total_amount,
  CASE 
    WHEN (mt.decin_count * 100.0 / mt.total_transactions) > ya.avg_decin_percentage THEN 'Above'
    WHEN (mt.decin_count * 100.0 / mt.total_transactions) < ya.avg_decin_percentage THEN 'Below'
    ELSE 'Equal'
  END AS comparison
FROM 
  monthly_transactions mt
CROSS JOIN 
  yearly_average ya;
```

```sql
    MIN(t.date) AS first_transaction_date,
```

```sql
WITH LowestConsumption AS (
  SELECT 
    Segment,
    MIN(Consumption) AS MinConsumption
  FROM 
    yearmonth
  WHERE 
    Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
  GROUP BY 
    Segment
),
AnnualAverage AS (
  SELECT 
    Segment,
    SUM(Consumption) / COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) AS AvgConsumption
  FROM 
    yearmonth
  WHERE 
    Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
  GROUP BY 
    Segment
)
SELECT 
  'SME vs LAM' AS Comparison,
  (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'SME') - 
  (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS Difference
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'LAM vs KAM' AS Comparison,
  (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - 
  (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS Difference
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'KAM vs SME' AS Comparison,
  (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - 
  (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS Difference;
```

```sql
WITH bond_counts AS (
  SELECT bond_type, COUNT(bond_id) AS total_occurrences
  FROM bond
  GROUP BY bond_type
),
most_common_bond AS (
  SELECT bond_type
  FROM bond_counts
  ORDER BY total_occurrences DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
molecule_bond_counts AS (
  SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(bond_id) AS bond_count
  FROM bond
  GROUP BY molecule_id
),
unique_element_pairs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a1.element, a2.element
  FROM atom a1
  JOIN connected c ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
  JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  WHERE b.bond_type = (SELECT bond_type FROM most_common_bond)
),
molecule_labels AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  WHERE b.bond_type = (SELECT bond_type FROM most_common_bond)
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
)
SELECT 
  bc.bond_type,
  bc.total_occurrences,
  COUNT(DISTINCT mbc.molecule_id) AS molecules_containing,
  AVG(mbc.bond_count) AS avg_bonds_per_molecule,
  COUNT(DISTINCT u.ep1) AS unique_element_pairs,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ml.label) AS molecule_labels
FROM 
  bond_counts bc
JOIN 
  most_common_bond mcb ON bc.bond_type = mcb.bond_type
JOIN 
  molecule_bond_counts mbc ON bc.bond_type = mbc.bond_type
JOIN 
  unique_element_pairs u ON bc.bond_type = u.bond_type
JOIN 
  molecule_labels ml ON bc.bond_type = ml.bond_type
GROUP BY 
  bc.bond_type, bc.total_occurrences;
```

```sql
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS count_of_molecules,
  AVG(cl_count) AS average_chlorine_atoms,
  MAX(cl_count) AS max_chlorine_atoms,
  AVG(bond_count) AS average_bonds,
  SUM(CASE WHEN single_bond_count > double_bond_count THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_of_molecules_with_more_single_bonds,
  AVG(bond_involving_cl_count) AS average_bonds_involving_chlorine
FROM 
  molecule m
JOIN 
  (SELECT 
     molecule_id, 
     COUNT(*) AS bond_count, 
     SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS single_bond_count, 
     SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS double_bond_count
   FROM 
     bond
   GROUP BY 
     molecule_id) b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN 
  (SELECT 
     molecule_id, 
     COUNT(*) AS cl_count, 
     SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bond_involving_cl_count
   FROM 
     atom
   GROUP BY 
     molecule_id) a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE 
  m.label = '-';
```

```sql
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS total_bonds,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carbon_atoms,
```

```sql
    AVG(SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = 'double' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS avg_num_double_bonds,
```

```sql
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nitrogen_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '#' AND a.element = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nitrogen_to_nitrogen_triple_bonds,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '#' AND a.element = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carbon_containing_triple_bonds,
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS total_triple_bonds
```

```sql
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+' AND atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'f')) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+') AS percentage_without_fluorine,
  AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS average_atoms_per_molecule,
  AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY molecule_id) AS average_bonds_per_molecule,
  AVG(CASE WHEN bond_type = '-' THEN 1 WHEN bond_type = '=' THEN 2 WHEN bond_type = '#' THEN 3 END) OVER () AS average_bond_strength
FROM 
  molecule
JOIN 
  atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
JOIN 
  bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
GROUP BY 
  molecule_id;
```
